profile_text.body:
Apple is a public company founded in 1976 and headquartered in Cupertino, CA. It reported revenue of $416,161,000,000 for the period ending September 27, 2025, and trades on public markets under the ticker AAPL with SEC CIK 0000320193. The company's website focuses on its AI and assistant offerings, describing a next-generation Apple Intelligence and Siri system it says is coming later this year for iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27.

Apple describes Apple Intelligence as AI that is integrated into apps, grounded in user context, and private at every step. The company's site presents Siri AI as a conversational assistant powered by Apple Intelligence, capable of open-ended questions, natural back-and-forth conversation, in-app actions across Messages, Music, and Reminders, on-screen visual queries, writing assistance, and Shortcuts automation. The site notes that Siri AI will launch in beta, initially in English, and will not be available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS, or watchOS at launch. Apple also tracks Final Cut Pro AI and iMovie AI as on-device, Apple silicon video editing products with a stated privacy-first approach.

The held facts list two MCP server entries associated with Apple: one for managing Apple Ads campaigns and reporting, and one providing Apple Developer Documentation with semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI reranking for MCP clients. No litigation is recorded in the held facts.
